build_hyperopt_optimizer: build a HyperOpt optimizer using nevergrad with TPE algorithm for hyperparameter optimization
create_search_space: create a hyperopt search space from a nevergrad Instrumentation parameter using _get_search_space
convert_parametrization_to_dict: convert a nevergrad parametrization object to a hyperopt compatible dictionary using _hp_parametrization_to_dict
convert_dict_to_parametrization: convert a hyperopt config dictionary back to a nevergrad parametrization using _hp_dict_to_parametrization
configure_parametrized_hyperopt: configure a ParametrizedHyperOpt optimizer with custom prior_weight n_startup_jobs and gamma parameters
